body: [{"streamId":"01a1adec-d245-7570-9f32-8236bc8dce2c","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskAdded","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a1adec-d245-7570-9f32-8236bc8dce2c\u0022,\u0022ProjectId\u0022:\u002201a1a29e-778a-7730-9f07-304d9ac0ffeb\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:\u0022On Windows, nothing in the daemon, the CLI, or the tests holds coanda.db open after the code that opened it is done with it, so moving, rebuilding, or deleting a home\\u0027s record never fails with \\u0027the process cannot access the file\\u0027.\u0022,\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:[\u0022Every place that closes the store or finishes with a SQLite connection before the record file is moved, replaced, or deleted (the rebuild\\u0027s move-aside, the export\\u0027s and rebuild\\u0027s home lock, daemon stop, and test home cleanup) releases pooled connections to that file first, for example with SqliteConnection.ClearPool or ClearAllPools, or opens those connections with pooling off.\u0022,\u0022RecordExportTests (including A_rebuild_that_fails_part_way_leaves_the_home_as_it_found_it and the two Neither_runs_while_a_daemon tests) and DaemonStartTests.Daemon_start_with_its_output_piped_returns_and_leaves_the_daemon_running pass on the windows CI leg; the pull request shows them passing in at least 20 consecutive runs of those test classes on Windows (a repeated filter run in one CI job is enough) and says how it ran them.\u0022,\u0022No test is skipped, retried, or loosened to pass; if a test itself leaked a connection, the pull request names the leak it fixed.\u0022,\u0022dotnet build --configuration Release succeeds with warnings as errors, and dotnet test --configuration Release --no-build passes on both CI legs.\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Bugfix\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022## Why\\n\\nSince PR #69 (export and rebuild) merged, the windows-latest CI leg fails intermittently with System.IO.IOException \\u0027The process cannot access the file ...\\\\coanda.db\\u0027: on main after PR #71 (RecordExportTests.A_rebuild_that_fails_part_way_leaves_the_home_as_it_found_it), on PR #69 itself (the two Neither_runs_while_a_daemon tests), and on PR #73 (DaemonStartTests.Daemon_start_with_its_output_piped_returns_and_leaves_the_daemon_running). Windows refuses to move or delete a file another handle holds, and Microsoft.Data.Sqlite pools connections by default, so a closed connection can still hold the file. Each such failure costs a fix lap on every pull request, and phase 3\\u0027s gate runs the real rebuild on the Windows machine.\\n\\nStart from src/Coanda.Daemon/Store/RecordRebuild.cs, RecordExport.cs, src/Coanda.Daemon/HomeLock.cs, StoreConfiguration.cs, and the test homes in tests/Coanda.Tests/Daemon/RecordHomes.cs. Confirm the cause before fixing; if it is not pooling, fix what it is and say so.\\n\\n## Non-goals\\n\\nNo change to the store\\u0027s schema, the export or rebuild behaviour on Linux or macOS, or any test\\u0027s assertions.
